env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '

cd a
cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/const_func_map_store_key.lgo main.lgo
logos eject -o out
cd out
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/const_func_map_store_key.out
cd ..
rm out

cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/const_for_index_shadow.lgo main.lgo
logos eject -o out
cd out
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/const_for_index_shadow.out
cd ..
rm out

cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/const_for_index_decls.lgo main.lgo
logos eject -o out
cd out
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/const_for_index_decls.out
cd ..
rm out

cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/const_func_map_range.lgo main.lgo
logos eject -o out
cd out
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/const_func_map_range.out
cd ..
rm out

module example.com/ccstoreshadow

go 1.27
